source.content: @isTest private class DataSoqlDynamicSelectorTest { @isTest static void exercisesDynamicSelectors() { insert new Account(Name = 'Acme', Rating = 'Hot'); insert new Account(Name = 'Beta', Rating = 'Warm'); String wanted = 'Acme'; String fields = 'Id, Name, Rating'; String queryText = 'SELECT ' + fields + ' FROM Account WHERE Name = :wanted ORDER BY Name'; List<Account> rows = Database.query(queryText); System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); Map<String,Object> binds = new Map<String,Object>(); binds.put('rating', 'Warm'); rows = Database.queryWithBinds('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Rating = :rating ORDER BY Name', binds, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); binds.put('filter.name', 'Beta'); rows = Database.queryWithBinds('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = :filter.name ORDER BY Name', binds, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); System.assertEquals('Beta', rows[0].Name); Integer betaCount = Database.countQuery('SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = \'Beta\'', AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, betaCount); Integer warmCount = Database.countQueryWithBinds('SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Rating = :rating', binds, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, warmCount); Database.QueryLocator plainLocator = Database.getQueryLocator('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = \'Beta\'', AccessLevel.USER_MODE); Object plainIterator = plainLocator.iterator(); System.assert(plainIterator.hasNext()); Account plainLocated = plainIterator.next(); System.assertEquals('Beta', plainLocated.Name); System.assert(!plainIterator.hasNext()); Database.QueryLocator locator = Database.getQueryLocatorWithBinds('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Rating = :rating ORDER BY Name', binds, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); Object iterator = locator.iterator(); System.assert(iterator.hasNext()); Account located = iterator.next(); System.assertEquals('Beta', located.Name); System.assert(!iterator.hasNext()); Boolean caught = false; try { Database.query('SELECT FROM Account'); } catch (QueryException qe) { caught = true; } System.assert(caught); } }
